_readme: Copy to .throughline/config.json at your repo root and edit. Strict JSON (no comments). Governs decomposing-requirements. max_iterations is a safety backstop on recursion depth, NOT the primary stop — the leaf test in the skill is. max_leaves is a sanity cap that signals over-decomposition. skip_if_atomic outputs a single leaf when the feature is already cohesive. The documentation block governs the documenting skill: each documenter has name/output/template/when (on-feature-complete|manual); template falls back to the plugin's bundled default if the file is absent. The models block is OPTIONAL: a flat map from a dispatched skill/stage name to ONE model string, plus a "*" fallback. Resolution is models[skill] then models["*"] then omit (inherit the session model). Model strings are in your harness's own namespace — the defaults below use Claude Code aliases (opus/sonnet/haiku); on opencode swap them for provider/model ids (e.g. ollama/qwen2.5-coder:14b), on Antigravity for Gemini ids. There is no primary key — throughline never sets the session/conductor model, only the models it dispatches as subagents.
